title: Crunchy Canadian Oat Pancakes
description: A delicious and healthy vegan pancake recipe made with crunchy oats and a hint of Canadian flavor. Perfect for a tasty breakfast or brunch.

ingredients.name: Crunchy Oats
ingredients.notes: Make sure to choose a crunchy or old-fashioned oat variety

ingredients.name: Vegan Milk
ingredients.notes: Choose your preferred type of plant-based milk

ingredients.name: Maple Syrup
ingredients.notes: Grade A amber maple syrup for the best flavor

ingredients.name: Vegan Egg Replacer
ingredients.notes: Follow package instructions for mixing ratio

ingredients.name: Sliced Banana
ingredients.notes: Optional topping for added flavor and texture

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, whisk together crunchy oats, vegan pancake mix, baking powder, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together vegan milk, maple syrup, and vegan egg replacer.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until well combined.
Heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat and brush with canola oil.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the batter onto the skillet or griddle.
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until bubbles appear on the surface and the edges start to dry.
Flip the pancakes and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes or until golden brown.
Serve warm with sliced banana on top, if desired.
Enjoy your delicious Crunchy Canadian Oat Pancakes!
